preconditions.description: The number of rooms n is between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.
There are exactly n-1 edges defining the tree structure.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and 1 <= v <= 1000000 for x, y, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two valid rooms with a positive weight v.
The number of queries q is between 1 and 50 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= 10**11 for l in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query value l is between 1 and 10^11 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly q lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a valid integer representing the maximum number of children.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(output_lines[i]) <= n for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: Each answer is a valid count of rooms between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(max_diff_condition_satisfied(i, queries[i], output_lines[i]) for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: For each query i, the answer represents the maximum size of a connected subgraph where the difference between the maximum and minimum 'farthest distance to ground' among its nodes is at most queries[i].
